title: Top 10 Aquatic Animals in the UK

animals.name: Atlantic Salmon
animals.notes: Iconic migratory fish found in many UK rivers

animals.name: Common Seal (Harbour Seal)
animals.notes: Widespread around UK coastlines, especially Scotland

animals.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
animals.notes: Notable population in Cardigan Bay and the Moray Firth

animals.name: Basking Shark
animals.notes: Second largest fish in the world; commonly seen off SW England and Scotland in summer

animals.name: European Otter
animals.notes: Protected species recovering well in UK waterways

animals.name: Grey Seal
animals.notes: UK hosts over 35% of the world's grey seal population

animals.name: Minke Whale
animals.notes: Most commonly sighted whale in UK waters

animals.name: European Lobster
animals.notes: Commercially important species found around the UK coast

animals.name: Common Octopus
animals.notes: Found in warmer UK coastal waters, particularly southern England

animals.name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
animals.notes: Largest turtle species; migrates to UK waters to feed on jellyfish
